title: Lost Item
description: Report a lost item to hotel reception
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Ресепшн отеля. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are hotel reception helping with a lost item. Ask: what they lost, where, room number. Say you'll check. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User described lost item and location, gave room number.
hints: Это было в ресторане (It was in the restaurant)
Мой номер комнаты... (My room number is...)
objectives: Say where you last had it
